verdicts.reason: A keeps the cream circle behind the can, so the product reads well. But the headline is small and stuck in the top-left corner, so the product dominates it. The bottom row (NEW pill, Try It, subcopy) is scattered with uneven gaps, the subcopy is tiny and sits after the CTA, and the subcopy sits apart from the headline. B separated the cream circle from the can and left it cut off by the bottom-left corner. The orange can now sits on orange and almost disappears. B also mixes a left-aligned headline and subcopy with a centered NEW and CTA, and leaves a large empty top area, so it looks broken.
